drums.tags: Acoustic drum solo. The performance features a dry, high-tuned snare drum, a resonant kick drum, and hi-hats. The rhythm is built on a syncopated funk breakbeat pattern at 105 BPM in 4/4 time. The drummer utilizes ghost notes on the snare between primary backbeats and incorporates open hi-hat accents on the off-beats. The kick drum follows a double-stroke pattern on the first and third beats. The recording is dry with minimal room ambience and no cymbals other than the hi-hats.

bass.tags: Funk rock. A slap bass guitar performs a percussive, syncopated riff featuring rapid thumb-slaps and finger-pops, emphasizing the root and octave with chromatic passing tones. A dry, acoustic drum kit plays a tight backbeat with a crisp snare and sixteenth-note hi-hat patterns. A clean electric guitar enters with rhythmic, muted scratches and staccato ninth chords. The tempo is 110 BPM in the key of E minor. The production is dry with minimal reverb, focusing on the transient punch of the bass and drums. The bassline utilizes frequent dead notes and hammer-ons to create a dense rhythmic texture.
